topic: 四因子等权低优合成分（低波动 + 超卖反转），固定持有期扣费回测
source: host-side exhaustive scan of the registered factor library (1614 single-factor configs + 2112 pairs + 3/4-factor composites); this file freezes the winner for native Niuniu re-computation. Host did NOT run the native verification.

host_scan_scope.triple_quad_combos: all 3/4-factor combinations containing ALPHA101.ALPHA28 from the top-60 field
host_scan_scope.multiple_testing_correction: none - top 6 candidates all landed at Sharpe 1.04-1.08, indicating a stable region rather than a single lucky point, but this is not a corrected claim

candidate.name: quad-low-composite
candidate.rationale: all four members had negative full-sample IC (lower factor value -> higher forward return). ATR and RETURN_VOLATILITY carry the low-volatility premium; ALPHA28 (volume-turnover correlation vs price) and SUMD_30 (up-day share of total movement) carry the oversold-reversal / weak-momentum premium. Equal-weight raw sum, no cross-sectional standardisation (the research pipeline has no standardisation entry point - a known product gap).

factors.formula: (up-day sum - down-day sum over 30d) / (total abs movement over 30d)

execution.symbols_rule: 2026-09-23 reference snapshot; stratified equal-spaced draw of 34 SH-main / 33 SZ-main / 33 ChiNext from the pool that is (a) qfq v2 history_truncated=false with valid_from<=2018-01-01 and (b) free of null OHLCV/adj_factor across the whole window. STAR board excluded (no eligible listing before 2018).
execution.known_sample_bias: excludes ~30% of symbols that had any suspended day in the window; STAR board absent; not the full investable market
execution.exit: close of the 40th trading day after entry

costs.note: stamp duty and transfer fee raised to the statutory rate of each trade date via execution.fees; 1 minimum price step per side

evaluation.pass_condition: native re-computation reproduces Sharpe >= 1.0 on the same window with the same cost model

holdout_split.note: host-side slice check gave 22.3% annualised / Sharpe 0.96 / max drawdown -1.6% on the verification period; native run must reproduce this

evaluation.baseline: equal-weight market index over the same window (8.0% annualised / Sharpe 0.44 / max drawdown -35.8%)
required_disclosures: not a bull-market strategy: full-year 2025 lagged the benchmark by 19 points
regime profile: large outperformance in bear/choppy years (2018 +19pp, 2022 +16pp, 2023 +17pp, 2024 +10pp), small underperformance in bull years
no multiple-testing correction across the 4000+ configurations searched
no impact cost; capacity untested on the full market
research_only qualification: not strict PIT, not official-rule covered

boundaries: host-side scan result; native Niuniu must re-compute through the official entry before this counts as verified
no execution grant, no broker connection, no order placement
negative results must be recorded as-is; no parameter re-search after seeing the native numbers
if the native run fails to reproduce, record implementation_failure and stop - do not re-tune
